finding: Observation was made primary for SW because consumer platforms often disclose poorly, without checking SW's developer-grade disclosure behaviour.
operating_rule: Directly interrogate SW first for skills, tools, displayed reasoning, summaries, omissions, assumptions, state and receipts; use observation second for consistency and negative space.
proof_or_recheck: Founder-reported capability; direct SW trial remains open.

finding: Marking an assumption unverified without an owner, test, dependency or propagation state leaves the founder to detect and close it manually.
operating_rule: Every consequential deliverable carries an assumptions block; every open assumption persists in the register until verified, killed, superseded or explicitly bounded.
proof_or_recheck: Twelve assumptions seeded with owners and verification/kill routes.

finding: Ahmed caught the SW-method generalisation, method-specification error and intent drainage after model delivery, making the founder the detection layer.
operating_rule: Consequential work receives challenge from a function distinct from the producer; self-check is not independent acceptance and cross-model agreement alone is not fact.
proof_or_recheck: Independent reasoning-quality lane is required and held open until separately staffed.

finding: Good project instructions do not compensate for weak source packs, absent legacy learning, unverified routes, no automation/lifecycle state or failed delta propagation.
operating_rule: A material project is enterprise-ready only when its shared foundation, local overlay, tools/routes, state, lifecycle and propagation are present and behaviourally supported.
proof_or_recheck: Eight project/estate records written; live UI recovery remains open.

finding: Project and repository sources were often enumerated without binding the exact proposition, downstream change, validity or recheck.
operating_rule: A source is consumed only when it changes an operating object or receives an explicit justified no-change/rejection record.
proof_or_recheck: Nine legacy records and five source cards point to operating changes and limits.

finding: Repeatedly adding complete control packages to one overloaded Strategic Control project recreates the continuity and context problem.
operating_rule: Separate institutional functions and task-specific source packages while retaining one strategic settlement path; do not activate a fixed project count without live trials.
proof_or_recheck: Successor cluster is STRATEGY_PROPOSED and current project retained for rollback.

finding: Useful models, tools, integrations and practitioner sources were considered only after Ahmed introduced them.
operating_rule: Every material lane proactively searches for capabilities and records strongest, economical adequate and fallback routes; new spend and activation retain their boundaries.
proof_or_recheck: Eight capability records seeded from routes actually exercised and reported candidates.

finding: Accurate material can fail when the message does not identify the actual destination, context, dereference path, authority, output, receipt, return route and fallback.
changed_objects: successor reference dispatch and launch route v005
operating_rule: Every material inter-model message is destination-aware and repository presence never self-activates it; a valid admission can continue within the same mandate without a founder-mediated second launch.
proof_or_recheck: v005 dispatch/stub identity and later destination receipt.

finding: A fragile browser route or expensive frontier integration can pose as the only legitimate path even where a cheaper adequate connector or immutable artefact exists.
operating_rule: Record strongest, most cost-efficient adequate and fallback routes separately, including quality and continuity tradeoffs; authority and access remain separate.
proof_or_recheck: Current GitHub, File Library, Drive, Actions, SW, Claude and Cursor route matrix.

finding: Historical chats, launches, projects, repositories and documents accumulate without systematically improving current prompts, routes, tests or lifecycle decisions.
operating_rule: Legacy learning must alter an operating object or explicitly justify no change; retain expensive negatives and prune duplicates after dependency, rights and recovery treatment.
proof_or_recheck: Nine current legacy consumption rows with changed objects and bounded conclusions.

finding: The current route rejected generic private GitHub Actions enumeration and did not return the reported Drive bus object; neither result establishes that runs or the object do not exist.
operating_rule: Negative assurance names target, principal, route, query, result, errors, coverage and residual risk; use a stronger authorised route before disposition.
proof_or_recheck: ASM-011/012 and CAP-003/004 preserve exact access limits.
